skills.name: fix-import-boundary
skills.description: Fixes a layer or feature-boundary violation from the boundary check (the gate's boundaries step, dependency-cruiser, eslint-plugin-boundaries) by moving code down, inverting the dependency, or using the public API. Use when the gate reports an "upward" or "internals of" import, a boundaries/element-types or no-restricted-paths error, or a circular dependency.

skills.name: split-oversized-file
skills.description: Splits a file that is over, or about to cross, the line cap (maxFileLines in quality.config.json) into cohesive units without changing behaviour — UI components, services, handlers, data tables, schemas and test files. Use when the ratchet reports "over the N-line cap" or "a file over N may not grow", when asked to "split this file", "break this up" or "this file is too big".
